# Perform Spread-Level test

<small>Source: [`man/performSpreadLevelTest.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/performSpreadLevelTest.Rd) · Help: `?performSpreadLevelTest`</small>

Tests the slope of `log(|residuals|)` on `log(fitted)`.

## Usage

```r
performSpreadLevelTest(model, data = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   an object of class `lm`.

`data`
:   optional data frame the model was fitted to. When `NULL`, the default, the model frame of `model` is used. The statistic is computed from the residuals and fitted values of `model`, so `data` does not change the result; it is accepted so that every test takes `(model, data, ...)`.

## Value

An object of class `htest`.

## Details

A slope near 0 indicates constant variance. A significant slope suggests a power transformation may stabilize the spread.

## References

Cleveland, W. S. (1979). Robust locally weighted regression and smoothing scatterplots. *Journal of the American Statistical Association*, 74(368), 829–836.

## Examples

```r
 data(mtcars)
 m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, data = mtcars)
 performSpreadLevelTest(m)
```
